reason.en: Find company registry records across jurisdictions.
reason.zh-TW: 查找不同司法管轄區的企業登記線索。

start.en: Search the full legal name and narrow by jurisdiction; follow the original registry link.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋完整公司名稱並限定登記地區，再查看原始登記來源。

limitations.en: Coverage and freshness vary by jurisdiction; verify against the official registry.
limitations.zh-TW: 地區覆蓋和更新速度不同，請回到官方登記資料核實。

reason.en: Look up official UK company registration and filings.
reason.zh-TW: 查詢英國官方公司登記和申報資料。

start.en: Search the company name or number, then compare status and filing history.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋公司名稱或編號，查看狀態和申報歷史。

limitations.en: UK only; a filed statement is not an independent guarantee of accuracy.
limitations.zh-TW: 僅適用英國；申報內容並非獨立核實的準確性保證。

reason.en: Read disclosures filed with the US SEC.
reason.zh-TW: 閱讀提交至美國 SEC 的公開披露。

start.en: Search the company name or ticker; check filing type and reporting date.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋公司名稱或股票代碼，確認申報類型及日期。

limitations.en: Covers SEC filers, not every US business.
limitations.zh-TW: 涵蓋 SEC 申報主體，不涵蓋所有美國企業。

reason.en: Find company, funding and industry background.
reason.zh-TW: 了解公司、融資和產業背景。

start.en: Search the company name and compare its website and location before using the profile.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋公司名稱，先核對官網和所在地，再使用該檔案。

limitations.en: Access may be limited or paid; profiles are secondary sources.
limitations.zh-TW: 存取可能受限或收費，檔案屬於二手來源。

reason.en: Find publicly shared professional and company profiles.
reason.zh-TW: 查找公開分享的職業及公司檔案。

start.en: Combine the name with an employer or profession; compare profile details.
start.zh-TW: 以姓名加上機構或職業搜尋，核對檔案細節。

limitations.en: Profiles are self-reported; visibility can require an account.
limitations.zh-TW: 檔案由使用者自行填寫，部分內容需要登入。

reason.en: Search published US federal government documents.
reason.zh-TW: 搜尋美國聯邦政府公開文件。

start.en: Search an exact name or phrase and check the document date and issuing body.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋完整名稱或片語，確認文件日期和發布機構。

limitations.en: US federal coverage; a name mention does not establish identity.
limitations.zh-TW: 以美國聯邦資料為主，名字出現並不代表身份相同。

reason.en: Check where a username appears on supported public platforms.
reason.zh-TW: 查看帳號名稱在哪些支援的平台出現。

start.en: Enter the exact username, open candidate profiles and compare public details.
start.zh-TW: 輸入完整帳號名稱，打開候選檔案並核對公開細節。

limitations.en: Matches can be false positives or different people.
limitations.zh-TW: 匹配可能是誤報，或屬於不同的人。

reason.en: Check public username matches using a command-line tool.
reason.zh-TW: 使用命令列查找公開帳號名稱的匹配。

start.en: Install using the project instructions, search a handle, then verify candidate links.
start.zh-TW: 依專案說明安裝，搜尋帳號名稱，再核實候選連結。

limitations.en: Requires installation; username matches are not identity proof.
limitations.zh-TW: 需要安裝；帳號名稱匹配不是身份證明。

reason.en: Compare older versions of a publicly archived website.
reason.zh-TW: 比較網站公開存檔的較早版本。

start.en: Paste the website URL, choose a snapshot date and compare content across dates.
start.zh-TW: 貼上網址，選擇存檔日期，對照不同日期的內容。

limitations.en: Pages may be missing or incomplete; snapshots do not prove ownership.
limitations.zh-TW: 頁面可能缺失或不完整，存檔不能證明擁有權。

reason.en: Explore available domain registration and DNS information.
reason.zh-TW: 查看可取得的網域登記和 DNS 資訊。

start.en: Enter a domain into the appropriate lookup and note the date of the record.
start.zh-TW: 在適合的查詢功能輸入網域，記錄資料日期。

limitations.en: Privacy services can hide registrant details; results may be historical.
limitations.zh-TW: 隱私服務可能隱藏登記人，結果也可能是歷史資料。

reason.en: Explore published DNS and related host information.
reason.zh-TW: 查看公開 DNS 和相關主機資訊。

start.en: Search the domain and inspect the returned DNS records as leads.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋網域，把返回的 DNS 記錄作為後續線索。

limitations.en: Coverage is incomplete; shared infrastructure does not imply common ownership.
limitations.zh-TW: 覆蓋不完整，共用基礎設施不代表相同擁有者。

reason.en: Identify technologies observed on a website.
reason.zh-TW: 了解網站被觀察到使用的技術。

start.en: Enter a domain and compare the reported stack with the current site.
start.zh-TW: 輸入網域，將技術報告與目前網站比較。

limitations.en: Detected technologies can be outdated; detailed reports may be paid.
limitations.zh-TW: 技術偵測可能過時，詳細報告可能收費。

reason.en: Find indexed copies of an image.
reason.zh-TW: 尋找已被索引的相同或相近圖片。

start.en: Upload an image or paste its URL; compare source pages and dates.
start.zh-TW: 上傳圖片或貼上圖片網址，核對來源頁面和日期。

limitations.en: No result does not prove originality; indexed coverage is limited.
limitations.zh-TW: 沒有結果不能證明原創，索引覆蓋有限。

reason.en: Look for visually similar images and possible source pages.
reason.zh-TW: 尋找視覺相似圖片及可能的來源頁面。

start.en: Use image search with an image or URL, then inspect matching pages.
start.zh-TW: 以圖片或網址使用圖片搜尋，再核對匹配頁面。

limitations.en: Visual resemblance is not proof of the same event or person.
limitations.zh-TW: 視覺相似不代表同一事件或人物。

reason.en: Inspect media and extract frames for further verification.
reason.zh-TW: 檢查媒體並擷取畫面，進行後續查證。

start.en: Install the extension and use extracted frames for reverse image searches.
start.zh-TW: 安裝擴充套件，再以擷取畫面進行反向圖片搜尋。

limitations.en: Requires a browser extension; findings still need corroboration.
limitations.zh-TW: 需要瀏覽器擴充套件，發現仍需其他來源佐證。

reason.en: Read metadata embedded in local files.
reason.zh-TW: 讀取本機文件內嵌的中繼資料。

start.en: Keep an original copy and follow ExifTool instructions to read its metadata.
start.zh-TW: 保留原始副本，依 ExifTool 說明讀取中繼資料。

limitations.en: Requires local software; metadata can be removed or manipulated.
limitations.zh-TW: 需要本機軟體，中繼資料可能被移除或修改。

reason.en: Check whether your email appears in indexed breach records.
reason.zh-TW: 檢查自己的信箱是否出現在已收錄的外洩記錄。

start.en: Enter your own email and review the listed breaches and dates.
start.zh-TW: 輸入自己的信箱，查看列出的外洩事件和日期。

limitations.en: Absence is not proof of safety; the index does not include every breach.
limitations.zh-TW: 查無結果不代表安全，資料庫不涵蓋所有外洩事件。

reason.en: Find published business email leads associated with a domain.
reason.zh-TW: 查找與企業網域相關的公開商務信箱線索。

start.en: Search a company domain and inspect the cited sources for each address.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋企業網域，核對每個信箱附帶的來源。

limitations.en: A suggested address can be outdated; access limits apply.
limitations.zh-TW: 建議地址可能過時，也可能有使用額度限制。

reason.en: Look up IP network ownership and approximate location.
reason.zh-TW: 查詢 IP 網路歸屬和估計位置。

start.en: Enter an IP and compare the network, ASN and location fields.
start.zh-TW: 輸入 IP，查看網路、ASN 和位置欄位。

limitations.en: IP geolocation cannot establish a person’s precise location.
limitations.zh-TW: IP 地理定位無法確認個人的精確位置。

reason.en: Review community reports associated with an IP.
reason.zh-TW: 查看與 IP 相關的社群舉報。

start.en: Look up an IP, checking report dates and categories rather than just a score.
start.zh-TW: 查詢 IP，查看舉報日期和類型，不只看分數。

limitations.en: Reports can be stale or mistaken; reputation is not a verdict.
limitations.zh-TW: 舉報可能過時或有誤，信譽分數不是定論。

reason.en: Add context to observed internet scanning activity.
reason.zh-TW: 了解被觀察到的網際網路掃描活動。

start.en: Search an IP and compare the observation dates and activity labels.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋 IP，核對觀察日期和活動標籤。

limitations.en: Unobserved activity does not imply a safe IP.
limitations.zh-TW: 未觀察到活動不代表 IP 安全。

reason.en: Compare landmarks and terrain with satellite imagery.
reason.zh-TW: 以衛星影像對照地標和地形。

start.en: Start from a candidate area and compare several visible features.
start.zh-TW: 從候選區域開始，對照多個可見特徵。

limitations.en: Imagery dates vary; current buildings or roads may differ.
limitations.zh-TW: 影像日期不同，現有建築或道路可能已改變。

reason.en: Compare scenes with contributed street-level imagery.
reason.zh-TW: 以使用者提供的街景影像對照場景。

start.en: Search a candidate location and check the capture date of nearby images.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋候選位置，確認附近影像的拍攝日期。

limitations.en: Coverage varies; images are contributed and may be old.
limitations.zh-TW: 覆蓋不同，影像由使用者提供，也可能過時。

reason.en: Read public Ethereum transactions and address activity.
reason.zh-TW: 閱讀以太坊公開交易及地址活動。

start.en: Choose Ethereum, paste an address or transaction hash and inspect the record.
start.zh-TW: 確認為以太坊，貼上地址或交易雜湊，查看記錄。

limitations.en: Address labels do not by themselves prove real-world identity.
limitations.zh-TW: 地址標籤本身不能證明現實身份。

reason.en: Inspect supported public blockchain transactions.
reason.zh-TW: 查看支援鏈上的公開交易。

start.en: Confirm the network, then search an address or transaction hash.
start.zh-TW: 確認所屬鏈，再搜尋地址或交易雜湊。

limitations.en: Network coverage varies; transactions do not identify a person by themselves.
limitations.zh-TW: 支援的链不同，交易本身不能識別個人身份。

reason.en: Explore transactions across supported blockchains.
reason.zh-TW: 查閱支援的多條區塊鏈上的交易。

start.en: Select the correct blockchain before entering an address or hash.
start.zh-TW: 先選擇正確區塊鏈，再輸入地址或雜湊。

limitations.en: Check chain-specific fields and availability; coverage is not universal.
limitations.zh-TW: 需核對各鏈欄位及可用性，並非支援所有鏈。

reason.en: China enterprise public information system.
reason.zh-TW: 中國大陸企業公開資訊查詢入口。

start.en: Search the company name or unified social credit code in the public information search.
start.zh-TW: 在企業資訊查詢中輸入完整公司名稱或統一社會信用代碼。

limitations.en: Mainland China; access may require verification. Automated access was blocked during this review; the full search flow has not been tested.
limitations.zh-TW: 適用中國大陸，存取可能需要驗證。本次自動存取被阻擋，尚未測試完整查詢流程。

reason.en: Taiwan public company and business registration search.
reason.zh-TW: 台灣公司及商業登記公開資料查詢入口。

start.en: Choose name or registration number search, then enter the company name or unified business number.
start.zh-TW: 選擇名稱或編號查詢，再輸入公司名稱或統一編號。

limitations.en: Taiwan registrations only. Automated access was blocked during this review; the full search flow has not been tested.
limitations.zh-TW: 僅適用台灣登記主體。本次自動存取被阻擋，尚未測試完整查詢流程。

reason.en: Official Hong Kong company registration search service.
reason.zh-TW: 香港公司註冊處的官方公司登記查冊服務。

start.en: Enter as a registered or unregistered online user and choose e-Search for the company name or business registration number.
start.zh-TW: 以已註冊或未註冊線上使用者進入，選擇電子查冊，以公司名稱或商業登記號碼查詢。

limitations.en: Hong Kong registrations; reports and document products may have fees. Review the current service fee schedule.
limitations.zh-TW: 適用香港登記主體，報告和文件產品可能收費，請確認當前收費表。

reason.en: Use a general search to discover original pages and name variants.
reason.zh-TW: 用通用搜尋尋找原始頁面與名稱變體。

start.en: Combine an exact phrase with a relevant organisation or domain.
start.zh-TW: 將完整名稱或說法搭配機構或網域搜尋。

limitations.en: Indexed results are incomplete and are not verified answers.
limitations.zh-TW: 索引結果不完整，也不是已核實答案。

reason.en: Find publications and compare their authors, dates and versions.
reason.zh-TW: 找出版文獻，並比較作者、日期與版本。

start.en: Search a title, topic or author, then inspect the original publication.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋標題、主題或作者，再閱讀原始出版資料。

limitations.en: Full text may require subscription; citations alone do not establish quality.
limitations.zh-TW: 全文可能需訂閱；引用次數本身不能證明品質。

reason.en: Look for existing checks of a specific claim.
reason.zh-TW: 找特定說法的既有查核。

start.en: Search the key phrase and read the evidence behind a relevant check.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋關鍵說法，再閱讀相關查核背後的證據。

limitations.en: Coverage is limited; no check found does not establish truth.
limitations.zh-TW: 涵蓋範圍有限；找不到查核不能證明說法真實。

reason.en: Read published fact checks and their cited sources, with a UK focus.
reason.zh-TW: 閱讀已發布查核及其引用來源，以英國議題為主。

start.en: Search a distinctive phrase, then inspect the checked claim, publication date and evidence links.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋有辨識度的原句，再核對查核對象、發布日期與證據連結。

limitations.en: A check applies to a specific claim and date. Read its evidence; no matching check is not proof of truth.
limitations.zh-TW: 查核針對特定說法與日期；需閱讀證據，找不到查核不能證明真實。

reason.en: Find Chinese-language fact checks and inspect the supporting evidence.
reason.zh-TW: 查找中文事實查核並閱讀支持證據。

start.en: Search a claim keyword and compare the original wording, report date and cited evidence.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋說法中的關鍵詞，比較原句、報告日期及引用證據。

limitations.en: A check applies to a specific claim and date. Read its evidence; no matching check is not proof of truth.
limitations.zh-TW: 查核針對特定說法與日期；需閱讀證據，找不到查核不能證明真實。

reason.en: Find candidate named entries with dataset provenance.
reason.zh-TW: 查找具有資料集出處的候選名稱條目。

start.en: Search a name, inspect its dataset and identifiers, then open the referenced source.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋名稱，核對資料集與識別資料，再打開引用來源。

limitations.en: Name matches are not identity conclusions. Dataset coverage and update dates vary.
limitations.zh-TW: 同名匹配不能確認身份；資料集涵蓋範圍與更新日期不同。

reason.en: Explore names and entities within the published offshore datasets.
reason.zh-TW: 在已發布的離岸資料集中查名稱與實體。

start.en: Search a name and record the dataset, source and dated relationships.
start.zh-TW: 搜尋名稱並記錄資料集、出處與有日期的關係。

limitations.en: The datasets are historical and incomplete. Inclusion does not itself imply illegal conduct.
limitations.zh-TW: 資料具有歷史性且不完整；被收錄本身不代表違法。

reason.en: Find records in the US federal court system.
reason.zh-TW: 查找美國聯邦法院系統記錄。

start.en: Review registration and fee requirements, then search by party or case identifiers.
start.zh-TW: 先查看註冊與費用條件，再依當事人或案件識別資料查詢。

limitations.en: Federal scope, not all state courts. A name or allegation does not establish identity or outcome.
limitations.zh-TW: 限聯邦範圍，不含所有州法院；姓名或指控不能確認身份或案件結果。

reason.en: The reference book identifies this as its companion list of resource links.
reason.zh-TW: 參考書在導言將此網站列為配套資源連結清單。

start.en: Choose a relevant topic, inspect a candidate link and check its required input, access and coverage on the original website.
start.zh-TW: 選相關主題，查看候選連結，再到原網站核對所需輸入、存取條件與涵蓋範圍。

limitations.en: This is a directory, not a subject lookup or verified database. Its individual links may change or become unavailable.
limitations.zh-TW: 這是目錄，並非對象查詢或已核驗資料庫；其中個別連結可能變更或失效。
